summary: Turbo Energy, S.A. filed a Form 6-K on April 28, 2026, announcing a press release regarding the deployment of its AI-driven energy storage and optimization platform in international military operations with the Spanish Army. The filing describes a product deployment for off-grid power solutions, not a special situation transaction. No stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or deal mechanics are provided. This is a routine operational update for a foreign private issuer, not an M&A, restructuring, or other event-driven category. The filing is incorporated by reference into an existing F-3 shelf registration.
